steps.content: The mechanical dragon falls from the sky. Cyrus standing on its head tumbles clumsily outside the city's wall, now a mere tiny black dot on the ground.
The intimidating final boss in the last round seems like a mob now. Before he even gets a chance to launch a self-destruction, he's dropped to the ground idiotically.
Watching Cyrus gasp for his last breaths, you finally get a chance to question him.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Where's the real Dragon of Genesis?

steps.speaker: Cyrus
steps.content: Hahahaha!
As if he's just heard the funniest joke of the century, Cyrus cackles uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Cyrus
steps.content: Dragon of Genesis? Dragon of Genesis! Look at you, you want to find it? In your dreams!
Even when defeated, Cyrus becomes animated when he talks about the Dragon of Genesis.

steps.speaker: Tierney
steps.content: Is something wrong in his head? Let's move on, it may screw up your brain if you talk to him for too long.
Nodding along on the side, Erwin points to the power source on Cyrus's chest and explains to you.

steps.speaker: Erwin
steps.content: We only need this fragment with the power of the Dragon of Genesis stored inside. Don't mind this pathetic pawn of fate.
You want to ask him something else, but the fighters who fought in the battle are gathering around you. Cheers echo through the entire city, as if you're the savior of this world.
Something feels off. Victory came too easily. The mechanical dragon's power seemed a lot weaker than before too.
The two turn their gazes at you, as if waiting for your decision.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Hold on for a bit longer.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Tick, tock, tick, tock. You can keep waiting, but they can't wait any longer.</color>
Once the joy of victory passes, Wing City resumes its construction of the small Forbidden Wall. No one outside your crew knows that this wall can only hold up for 36 hours.
Very soon, under the castellan's order, the soldiers remove from Cyrus the power source supporting the mechanical dragon and bring it to you.

steps.speaker: Erwin
steps.content: The Dragon of Genesis is located... on the land where everything is frozen by ice and snow.
Sensing the power source's fluctuations, Erwin looks below the Isle of Sky.

steps.speaker: Tierney
steps.content: Finally, we get a chance to pilot a skyraft! I hope you're not prone to motion sickness, Chosen One?
Tierney looks at you with a smile, producing several pills from her clothes.

steps.speaker: Tierney
steps.content: Just a heads up, if you start feeling seasick, let me know, okay? I tend to drive pretty fast.
